lessons.title: Marketing Foundations
lessons.content: Marketing identifies, creates, communicates, and delivers value profitably. It's not just promotion — it's understanding needs deeply. KEY CONCEPTS: Right product, right people, right message, right time and price. WORKED EXAMPLE: A brand wins by solving a specific frustration competitors ignore. PRACTICE: 1) Define your customer's core need. 2) State your value in one sentence. 3) Name who it's NOT for.
